title: find_crlf in fetch.rs uses O(n) window scan; could use memchr for performance
description: fetch.rs find_crlf() uses data.windows(2).position(...) which is O(n) on every call. dot_stuff() and bytes_to_lines() call this in a loop over all lines of the article body, making the overall complexity O(n^2) in pathological cases (many short lines with CRLF). For typical articles this is fine, but for large text articles near the 1 MiB limit this could be slow. The memchr crate (already likely in the dependency tree) provides a SIMD-accelerated memmem/memchr that would be significantly faster. Not a critical hot path but worth flagging for future optimization.
